lines: Aur ahista kijiye baatein,
Dhadkanein koi sun raha hoga.
couplets.en: Speak a little more softly, someone might hear our hearts beating.

lines: Aur ahista kijiye baatein,
Dhadkanein koi sun raha hoga.
couplets.en: Speak a little more softly, someone might hear our hearts beating.

lines: Dar-o-deewar raaz ki saari baat sun lenge,
To aur ahista kijiye baatein.
couplets.en: The doors and walls will hear our every secret, so speak a little more softly.

lines: Aise bolo ke dil ka afsana,
Dil sune aur nigah dohraye.
couplets.en: Speak so the heart can hear its own story and the eyes can tell it again.

lines: Aise bolo ke dil ka afsana,
Dil sune aur nigah dohraye.
couplets.en: Speak so the heart can hear its own story and the eyes can tell it again.

lines: Apne chaaron taraf ki ye duniya saans ka shor bhi na sun paaye,
Aur ahista kijiye baatein, dhadkanein koi sun raha hoga.
couplets.en: Let the world around us hear neither breath nor heartbeat, and speak a little more softly.

lines: Lafz girne na paayein honton se,
Waqt ke haath inko chun lenge.
couplets.en: Let no words fall from your lips, for time will gather them up.

lines: Kaan rakhte hain ye dar-o-deewar,
Raaz ki saari baat sun lenge.
couplets.en: These doors and walls have ears and will hear our every secret.

lines: Aur ahista kijiye baatein.
Aaj itne qareeb aa jaao,
Dooriyon ka kahin, dooriyon ka kahin.
couplets.en: Come so close today that the distance between us fades.

lines: Aaj itne qareeb aa jaao,
Dooriyon ka kahin nishaan na rahe.
couplets.en: Come so close today that no trace of distance remains.

lines: Aaj itne qareeb aa jaao,
Dooriyon ka kahin nishaan na rahe.
couplets.en: Come so close today that no trace of distance remains.

lines: Aise ek doosre mein gum ho jaayein, faasla koi darmiyaan na reh jaaye,
Aur ahista kijiye baatein, dhadkanein koi sun raha hoga.
couplets.en: Let us lose ourselves in each other till no space remains between us, and speak softly lest someone hear our hearts.

lines: Lafz girne na paayein honton se,
Waqt ke haath.
couplets.en: Let no words fall from your lips into the hands of time.
